app.name: Keypad
app.summary: A keypad on the screen: the right code unlocks a lock, opens a cover or switches a light, a script or a scene.
app.target_hint: What the right code switches: a lock, a cover, a switch, a light, a script, a scene or a button.
app.code_hint: 4 to 8 digits. The screen checks it, so it is stored on the screen: use it for convenience, not as your only lock.
app.attempts_hint: After this many wrong codes in a row the keypad waits before it takes another.
app.wait_hint: How long the keypad waits, in seconds.
